entry_points.text: Single value checks pack by allocating zeroed sized buffer, transferring with value range size and quirks, requiring success and byte equality, and unpack by reusing stored buffer requiring success and value equality, both in a common suite. Multi field checks pack fixed record into eight bytes with full comparison and unpack fixed bytes into zeroed record with per field comparison, under one suite terminated by empty entry. Arithmetic check compares native and per processor scalars across widths through updates around zero negative one all bits and thirty two bit wrap, warning on mismatch while blocking preemption, logging start and finish, and requesting unload via error with inert exit.

exports.text: Pool creation validates limits, aligns size to word, derives power of two capacity, records counts flags context and cleanup, builds slot array and per processor slots with reference preset to retained plus one, cleaning on failure. Teardown releases slots virtual aware and runs cleanup once. Single release frees only on last reference else retries; bulk drain extracts retained objects then frees. Manager creates from operations with base limit and algorithm, destroys, inits and finis priorities by sorted insertion, adds or removes via algorithm; destroying nonempty manager or finalizing nonempty priority warns so callers drain first.

Token lookup scans table until pattern matches and returns its token with captures. Absent pattern matches; otherwise literals compare and conversions handle escaped percent, nonempty strings with optional cap, and signed unsigned octal hex numbers needing one converting character. Signed conversion uses bounded temporary, reports range when slice too large, parses with caller base, reports invalid when nothing converts and range outside integer limits. Sixty four bit and unsigned share bounded copy then delegate with automatic and decimal bases. Slice copy reports full length while truncating safely; duplication allocates exact terminated copy. Reference init takes release flags mode, starts atomic when requested else per processor with bias plus one, supports dead start, aligns storage; exit releases storage, folds count under lock and drops data, cleaning partial storage and reporting pending switch.

hazards.text: Numeric conversion uses twenty four byte temporary and bias reserves high bit of unsigned long for per processor mode. Remaining symbols are owned elsewhere covering bit reversal, compiler annotations, debugfs removal, warnings, topology, masks and counts, error helpers, jump labels, mutex, pool extraction, reconfig notifiers, refcounts, slab allocation, packing helpers, per processor allocation and atomic updates.

invariants.text: Lookup hashes length and weighted bytes with folded shifts then binary searches by hash length and reverse bytes tails first, returning enumeration or sentinel. Parsing needs three bytes with tag and length equal payload then resolves via lookup. Rendering needs nonempty input, splits first byte by base forty, decodes base one twenty eight chains, emits decimals, fails on exhausted space or truncation and marks malformed input. Transfer treats start as inclusive high and end as inclusive low, rejects inverted ranges, out of range start and widths above sixty four. Internal transfer handles affected boxes with intersection, masking, remap by word and endian quirks in groups of four with clamped tail, optional bit reversal, preserving unrelated bits on store or accumulating on load. Structure conversion moves one two four or eight bytes defaulting wider to eight. Bulk helpers walk descriptors via intermediate value for narrow and wide forms. Direction selects store or load, zero quirks mean default layout, errors distinguish invalid arguments, memory, retry, encoding, space and width.

Pool construction visits all processors, skips never possible, distributes objects evenly with remainder early, sizes slots as descriptor plus objects, prefers virtual except atomic with node fallback, clears and initializes with failure propagation; teardown tolerates missing arrays and releases virtual aware. Control holds counts, size, capacity, flags, context, cleanup and slot array. Manager holds operations, context, algorithm, count, limit and priority list with linear sorted implementation. Capacity grows by one step committing only on success; shrinking leaves state below base else resizes. Priority is used when list nonempty with edge helpers. Linear order keeps dense indices with new index after nearest used at or below else zero, shifts by single moves with relinking, and add or remove enlarges, shifts, updates count and shrinks when spare reaches one step.

Total is global plus shards; folding local and dying shards into global preserves total with stable exact summation. Batch defaults to thirty two and tracks larger of thirty two and twice online count. Comparison trusts cheap read when far from threshold by more than batch per online processor else sums exactly. Bounded addition can succeed lockless within batch when uncertainty keeps allowed side, otherwise decides under lock and folds local on success. Each instance has raw lock for global; global lock guards registry with group allocation linking and teardown unlinking under blocked interrupts, nesting instance locks for dying handling. Group allocation carves one area into slices, fails cleanly and nulls on teardown. Debug activates with fixup, inert otherwise, while hotplug joins registry and startup warns on failure.

Insertion keeps ascending priority scanning inward from both ends, removal promotes same priority successor when victim represented group, requeue moves interior member to end of equal group doing nothing for final member or priority mismatch. Each head keeps full chain plus first per priority representatives with others empty; removal reinitializes linkages and requeue preserves grouping. Insertion expects detached linkages and requeue expects nonempty head with queued member, debug checking consistency while alternate builds compile checks away. Heads expose iteration and nodes carry priority plus linkages; tests use one head with two hundred forty one nodes for randomized checks plus drain and timed cost.

locks.text: Non sleepable guards done check with spinlock saving interrupts, restoring on early done or finish with annotations; sleepable uses mutex likewise. Start reports whether caller runs payload while finish marks completion, releases and schedules deferred deactivation. Flag starts false with optimization enabled, first starter proceeds, later starters skip, worker asserts enabled before disabling. Carrier holds work plus jump key and module, created on finishing path and consumed to disable, release module and free. Deferral allocation is atomic and silently leaves optimization enabled on failure, while duplicated disable would trap.

Logging prefixes function name and accessor clears flag bits to recover per processor pointer. Mode dead force and completion serialize under switch lock with interrupts blocked; helper sleeps while pending dropping lock, completion clears pending and wakes all with zero sampling under same lock in atomic mode. Only live unforced objects may use per processor counting with set callback marking transition and one wake defaulting to no operation. Bias prevents false empty during folding, restored on return and removed when folding, with bad values reported with limited repetition. Operations force atomic persistently, force synchronously until visible, restore per processor, mark dead once releasing initial hold with optional confirmation, query zero, and revive dead zero by clearing dead and acquiring hold. Repeated marking, bad revives, restoring without permission and reinit without zero warn once, while missing shards or bad values trigger fatal or warning diagnostics.

state_machines.text: Injection moves absent to armed when directory creation and registration succeed, returns to absent with removal on registration failure, and returns on exit by unregistering then removing. Init creates directory and registers for attach detach add remove and update property with configurable priority; exit unregisters and removes.

structs.text: Test records hold description, expected buffer with size, value, bit range and quirks. Tests use packed eight byte buffer and mixed record with one thirty two bit plus three sixteen bit plus two eight bit members, partitioned by six descriptors most to least significant over sixty four bits. Single vectors use two patterns plus all ones at aligned and odd positions in zeroed buffers across default and word first little endian and bit reversed quirks. Multi field buffers are eight bytes. Power notifier fragment declares only file local integer priority.
